You can open a Lifetime ISA if you're aged 18 to 39. Withdrawals for other reasons than those below incur a 25% government charge. The no-charge reasons are:
- buying a first home costing £450,000 or less, once the account has been open for at least 12 months
- being aged 60 or over
- being terminally ill with less than 12 months to live

The documents list these changes from 6 April 2027:

- **Transfers:** You will no longer be able to transfer from stocks and shares or innovative finance ISAs into cash ISAs.
- **Interest charge:** A charge will apply to interest paid on cash held inside a stocks and shares or innovative finance ISA.
- **Existing cash ISAs:** Money already in cash ISAs is not affected by the cap.

More detail is in the ISA guide: https://www.fernhillwealth.example/guides/isas/
